status: Production scripts; story state effects and ending selection still require game implementation and testing. Do not play a response unless its effect was actually applied.

scenes.title: At the Gate
scenes.narration: Three houses offer you an audience. Their interests differ, and your first introduction will be remembered. Whose invitation will you accept?

choices.label: House Stark
choices.response: The northern delegation grants you an audience.

choices.label: House Tyrell
choices.response: The Reach delegation grants you an audience.

choices.label: House Martell
choices.response: The Dornish delegation grants you an audience.

scenes.title: A Public Promise
scenes.narration: Your hosts ask what you will defend when power becomes costly. You must offer a promise before asking for their support.

choices.label: Protect civilians
choices.response: You pledge to protect the people.

choices.label: Honor agreements
choices.response: You pledge to honor your agreements.

choices.label: Defend allies
choices.response: You pledge to defend your allies.

scenes.title: An Empty Purse
scenes.narration: A messenger needs help reaching your hosts. You have little to spare, but there are several ways to assist.

choices.label: Give supplies
choices.response: You part with supplies to help the messenger.

choices.label: Offer escort
choices.response: You give your time to escort the messenger.

choices.label: Find shelter
choices.response: You arrange shelter for the messenger.

scenes.title: The Whisper
scenes.narration: A stranger offers a rumor about your hosts. It could be useful, but nothing has been proven. What will you do with it?

choices.label: Seek evidence
choices.response: You begin checking the stranger’s account.

choices.label: Tell hosts
choices.response: You warn your hosts that a rumor is spreading.

choices.label: Keep quiet
choices.response: You keep the rumor to yourself for now.

scenes.title: A Seat Offered
scenes.narration: Your hosts offer a place among their supporters. They expect something in return. Decide what you can honestly commit.

choices.label: Offer service
choices.response: You offer your service without a permanent oath.

choices.label: Swear loyalty
choices.response: You bind your claim to a formal oath.

choices.label: Remain independent
choices.response: You preserve your independence and decline their protection.

scenes.title: Your First Departure
scenes.narration: Before you leave, choose how to establish your own reputation. This will become part of the story people tell about your claim.

choices.label: Thank hosts
choices.response: You publicly acknowledge those who welcomed you.

choices.label: Meet townsfolk
choices.response: You spend your remaining time among the townsfolk.

choices.label: Recruit advisers
choices.response: You seek advisers for the road ahead.

scenes.title: The Prisoner
scenes.narration: Your guards bring you a captured courier from a rival faction. They carry a sealed message. How will you begin?

choices.label: Hear account
choices.response: You give the courier a chance to explain.

choices.label: Read message
choices.response: You open the courier’s sealed message.

choices.label: Call witness
choices.response: You ask a witness to join the questioning.

scenes.title: Terms of Custody
scenes.narration: The courier must remain with you while their story is checked. Your guards ask how they should be treated.

choices.label: Guarded room
choices.response: You order secure and humane confinement.

choices.label: Strict watch
choices.response: You order a stricter watch on the captive.

choices.label: Trusted keeper
choices.response: You place the captive with a trusted keeper.

scenes.title: The Ransom Offer
scenes.narration: A rival offers money for the courier’s return. The payment could help your claim, but accepting it creates a public bargain.

choices.label: Ask supplies
choices.response: You request supplies instead of gold.

choices.label: Ask gold
choices.response: You name a price in gold.

choices.label: Decline bargain
choices.response: You decline the proposed ransom.

scenes.title: An Exchange
scenes.narration: An intermediary suggests exchanging the courier for someone held by the rival. Who should benefit from your negotiation?

choices.label: Your ally
choices.response: You negotiate for an allied prisoner.

choices.label: Local captives
choices.response: You negotiate for imprisoned townsfolk.

choices.label: Seek guarantee
choices.response: You request proof before agreeing to an exchange.

scenes.title: The Final Terms
scenes.narration: You must now decide the courier’s fate. Mercy, payment, and exchange each leave a different obligation behind.

choices.label: Release freely
choices.response: You release the courier without demanding payment.

choices.label: Accept ransom
choices.response: The agreed ransom is paid, and the courier leaves.

choices.label: Arrange exchange
choices.response: The agreed exchange returns a prisoner to your protection.

scenes.title: Who Hears First
scenes.narration: The courier has departed. Decide who receives your account of the negotiation before rumors begin filling the gaps.

choices.label: Tell allies
choices.response: You send your allies an account of the bargain.

choices.label: Tell public
choices.response: You make the outcome public.

choices.label: Keep records
choices.response: You preserve a private record of the negotiation.

scenes.title: The Proposal
scenes.narration: A powerful family proposes a marriage alliance. Before responding, decide what you need to know about their offer.

choices.label: Ask intentions
choices.response: You ask what the family expects from the alliance.

choices.label: Review terms
choices.response: You request the full terms in writing.

choices.label: Meet partner
choices.response: You request a private conversation with the proposed partner.

scenes.title: A Prior Obligation
scenes.narration: Your advisers remind you to examine earlier commitments before accepting new ones. How will you check for conflicts?

choices.label: Review promises
choices.response: You review your recorded promises.

choices.label: Consult allies
choices.response: You ask your allies how this agreement affects them.

choices.label: Seek counsel
choices.response: You seek an independent adviser’s judgment.

scenes.title: The Price
scenes.narration: The family wants a public concession as part of the agreement. Which term are you willing to discuss?

choices.label: Trade rights
choices.response: You offer to negotiate trading rights.

choices.label: Council seat
choices.response: You offer to negotiate a council seat.

choices.label: No concession
choices.response: You refuse an additional concession.

scenes.title: The Other Voice
scenes.narration: Your proposed partner has concerns of their own. The agreement will shape both your lives. How will you respond?

choices.label: Hear concerns
choices.response: You give your prospective partner room to speak.

choices.label: Revise terms
choices.response: You reopen the terms for discussion.

choices.label: Request delay
choices.response: You ask for time before making a commitment.

scenes.title: The Agreement
scenes.narration: The terms are before you. Accepting creates an alliance; refusing preserves your freedom to choose a different path.

choices.label: Accept terms
choices.response: You accept the agreement and its obligations.

choices.label: Decline respectfully
choices.response: You decline the marriage without making a new pledge.

choices.label: Offer treaty
choices.response: You propose a treaty in place of marriage.

scenes.title: The Announcement
scenes.narration: Others will judge this decision by how you explain it. Choose what to emphasize when you announce your position.

choices.label: Shared duties
choices.response: You emphasize the duties each side must honor.

choices.label: Realm’s welfare
choices.response: You emphasize what the agreement means for the realm.

choices.label: Your ambition
choices.response: You openly state how this decision serves your claim.

scenes.title: The Charge
scenes.narration: A formal accusation of treason threatens your position. You have time to prepare a response, but rumors are moving faster.

choices.label: Demand details
choices.response: You demand the specific charges and evidence.

choices.label: Seek counsel
choices.response: You seek counsel before answering.

choices.label: Contact allies
choices.response: You ask your allies for assistance.

scenes.title: A Witness
scenes.narration: A witness offers information that may help your defense. Their account must be handled carefully.

choices.label: Check account
choices.response: You check the witness’s account against the records.

choices.label: Provide protection
choices.response: You arrange protection for the witness.

choices.label: Record testimony
choices.response: You preserve the testimony for the hearing.

scenes.title: The Offer
scenes.narration: An intermediary offers to negotiate reduced penalties. A settlement may preserve freedom while weakening your claim.

choices.label: Hear terms
choices.response: You agree to hear the proposed settlement.

choices.label: Reject offer
choices.response: You reject the offer and continue your defense.

choices.label: Ask mediator
choices.response: You request an independent mediator.

scenes.title: A Champion
scenes.narration: Trial by combat remains an option. Before risking your defense on it, consider whether anyone will willingly stand for you.

choices.label: Ask volunteer
choices.response: You ask for a willing champion.

choices.label: Consult guards
choices.response: You discuss the risks with your guards.

choices.label: Keep evidence
choices.response: You keep your defense focused on evidence.

scenes.title: Your Defense
scenes.narration: The hearing begins. Choose the defense you are prepared to support. Your claim will survive this chapter, but the cost may differ.

choices.label: Present evidence
choices.response: Your evidence is entered into the hearing.

choices.label: Seek settlement
choices.response: You submit negotiated terms for judgment.

choices.label: Request combat
choices.response: You formally request trial by combat.

scenes.title: After the Hearing
scenes.narration: The hearing leaves your position uncertain. You must decide where to direct your efforts while the judgment is carried out.

choices.label: Rebuild trust
choices.response: You begin repairing strained relationships.

choices.label: Secure shelter
choices.response: You secure a place for your household.

choices.label: Preserve records
choices.response: You preserve the records of your defense.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Patron
scenes.narration: A patron offers help rebuilding your position. Before accepting, choose what matters most to understand.

choices.label: Ask cost
choices.response: You ask what repayment will be expected.

choices.label: Check motives
choices.response: You investigate the patron’s interests.

choices.label: Consult council
choices.response: You bring the offer before your council.

scenes.title: The Gift
scenes.narration: The patron offers a choice of support. Each could strengthen a different part of your household.

choices.label: Take supplies
choices.response: You accept supplies and record the obligation.

choices.label: Take shelter
choices.response: You accept shelter and record the obligation.

choices.label: Take gold
choices.response: You accept gold and record the obligation.

scenes.title: Repayment
scenes.narration: Your patron asks how you intend to repay their help. Do not promise more than you can defend later.

choices.label: Fixed repayment
choices.response: You propose repayment with a clear limit.

choices.label: Future favor
choices.response: You promise a future favor.

choices.label: Offer service
choices.response: You offer service in place of repayment.

scenes.title: A Strained Household
scenes.narration: Members of your household disagree over how to use the help. What will guide your allocation?

choices.label: Protect vulnerable
choices.response: You direct aid toward the most vulnerable.

choices.label: Restore defenses
choices.response: You direct aid toward your defenses.

choices.label: Divide evenly
choices.response: You distribute the available aid evenly.

scenes.title: The Patron’s Request
scenes.narration: Your patron asks for an additional concession beyond the recorded agreement. How will you answer?

choices.label: Honor terms
choices.response: You insist on the terms already agreed.

choices.label: Negotiate change
choices.response: You open negotiations over the new request.

choices.label: Grant request
choices.response: You agree to the additional concession.

scenes.title: A New Foundation
scenes.narration: With immediate needs addressed, choose the foundation you want to strengthen for the coming struggle.

choices.label: Build reserves
choices.response: You set aside resources for future shortages.

choices.label: Repair alliances
choices.response: You invest effort in repairing alliances.

choices.label: Gather intelligence
choices.response: You seek better information about your rivals.

scenes.title: The Storehouse
scenes.narration: Your stores are lower than expected. Before allocating what remains, decide how to assess the shortage.

choices.label: Count supplies
choices.response: You order a fresh count of the stores.

choices.label: Check records
choices.response: You examine the supply records.

choices.label: Hear stewards
choices.response: You hear directly from the stewards.

scenes.title: The First Rations
scenes.narration: Food must be distributed today. Every allocation leaves someone with less than they hoped.

choices.label: Feed families
choices.response: You give priority to civilian households.

choices.label: Feed soldiers
choices.response: You give priority to the soldiers.

choices.label: Share equally
choices.response: You divide the food equally.

scenes.title: A Loan
scenes.narration: A lender offers provisions against future repayment. The terms could burden your claim long after the shortage ends.

choices.label: Review terms
choices.response: You examine the lender’s conditions.

choices.label: Offer collateral
choices.response: You offer collateral for revised terms.

choices.label: Refuse loan
choices.response: You refuse the loan and its obligations.

scenes.title: The Supply Road
scenes.narration: Reports suggest a supply route may be unsafe. How will you prepare before sending another convoy?

choices.label: Send scouts
choices.response: You send scouts to assess the route.

choices.label: Seek escort
choices.response: You request an escort for the convoy.

choices.label: Change route
choices.response: You choose a different supply route.

scenes.title: A Public Explanation
scenes.narration: The shortage has become impossible to hide. Your people deserve an explanation of the choices made in their name.

choices.label: Share accounts
choices.response: You publish the supply accounts.

choices.label: Hold council
choices.response: You invite representatives to question the council.

choices.label: Give assurance
choices.response: You offer a public assurance of continued relief efforts.

scenes.title: Preparing for Winter
scenes.narration: Immediate relief has bought time. Decide how to reduce the chance of another crisis.

choices.label: Improve storage
choices.response: You invest in safer storage.

choices.label: Secure trade
choices.response: You pursue more dependable trading agreements.

choices.label: Build reserves
choices.response: You set aside a protected emergency reserve.

scenes.title: A Broken Confidence
scenes.narration: Private council information has reached a rival. Suspicion alone does not identify who betrayed you. Where will you begin?

choices.label: Trace message
choices.response: You investigate how the message traveled.

choices.label: Question council
choices.response: You question the council about the disclosure.

choices.label: Protect records
choices.response: You secure the remaining private records.

scenes.title: The Accusation
scenes.narration: An adviser names a suspect, but their account is incomplete. What will you require before acting?

choices.label: Seek evidence
choices.response: You request evidence supporting the accusation.

choices.label: Hear suspect
choices.response: You give the accused a chance to respond.

choices.label: Find witness
choices.response: You seek an independent witness.

scenes.title: A Private Confession
scenes.narration: A council member admits sharing information, claiming they intended to prevent a worse outcome. How will you examine that claim?

choices.label: Check motive
choices.response: You investigate their stated motive.

choices.label: Review damage
choices.response: You assess what the disclosure has cost.

choices.label: Call mediator
choices.response: You bring in a mediator for the dispute.

scenes.title: The Consequence
scenes.narration: The disclosure is confirmed. You must respond without allowing suspicion to consume the rest of your council.

choices.label: Remove adviser
choices.response: You remove the adviser from the council.

choices.label: Restrict access
choices.response: You restrict the adviser’s access to private information.

choices.label: Offer conditions
choices.response: You offer a conditional path to regain trust.

scenes.title: Restoring the Council
scenes.narration: Your remaining advisers watch how you respond to the breach. Choose a step toward rebuilding a working council.

choices.label: Clarify duties
choices.response: You clarify each adviser’s responsibilities.

choices.label: Share evidence
choices.response: You share the verified evidence with the council.

choices.label: Renew commitments
choices.response: You ask the council to renew its commitments.

scenes.title: Before the Final Season
scenes.narration: The final struggle approaches. Decide which part of your claim needs attention before the last chapter begins.

choices.label: Contact allies
choices.response: You contact your allies before the final season.

choices.label: Review debts
choices.response: You review the debts still attached to your claim.

choices.label: Secure household
choices.response: You strengthen your household’s immediate security.

scenes.title: The Final Assembly
scenes.narration: Representatives gather to hear your claim. Your history has arrived with you. How will you open your appeal?

choices.label: Cite service
choices.response: You open by describing your service to the realm.

choices.label: Cite alliances
choices.response: You open by naming the alliances behind your claim.

choices.label: Cite stability
choices.response: You open with your plans for stability.

scenes.title: Outstanding Promises
scenes.narration: The assembly asks which obligations you will honor if your claim succeeds. Your answer must stand beside your recorded choices.

choices.label: Honor debts
choices.response: You commit to honoring your recorded debts.

choices.label: Seek new terms
choices.response: You ask to renegotiate outstanding obligations openly.

choices.label: Reject demands
choices.response: You reject the demands placed before the assembly.

scenes.title: A Rival’s Offer
scenes.narration: A rival offers an agreement that could change the final contest. Its value depends on what you are willing to surrender.

choices.label: Hear bargain
choices.response: You hear the rival’s proposed bargain.

choices.label: Offer compromise
choices.response: You propose a compromise of your own.

choices.label: Stand apart
choices.response: You refuse a bargain with this rival.

scenes.title: The Last Council
scenes.narration: Your advisers disagree over the last appeal. Choose whose argument deserves your closest attention before you decide.

choices.label: Listen allies
choices.response: You listen to the allies who remain with you.

choices.label: Listen people
choices.response: You hear the people’s representatives.

choices.label: Listen counsel
choices.response: You hear independent counsel on your position.

scenes.title: Your Final Terms
scenes.narration: There is one last chance to state the terms on which you seek power. Every promise now becomes part of your final claim.

choices.label: Accept limits
choices.response: You accept stated limits on your authority.

choices.label: Share authority
choices.response: You propose sharing authority with a council.

choices.label: Claim authority
choices.response: You press your claim to undivided authority.

scenes.title: The Judgment
scenes.narration: Your final appeal awaits. No speech can erase the journey behind you. How will you face the judgment of your claim?

choices.label: Speak plainly
choices.response: You present your final appeal without concealment.

choices.label: Invoke promises
choices.response: You remind the assembly of its promises and yours.

choices.label: Trust supporters
choices.response: You let your remaining supporters speak for your claim.
